definitions.gloss: long-cherished wish; heart's desire; long-held dream
definitions.explanation: A wish or goal that someone has held for a long time. Used when that wish is finally fulfilled or when describing something someone has always wanted.

examples.japanese: {念願|ねんがん}の{夢|ゆめ}が{叶|かな}った。
{念願|ねんがん}のマイホームをやっと{手|て}に{入|い}れた。
examples.english: I finally got the home I had always dreamed of.

examples.japanese: {十年|じゅうねん}{越|ご}しの{念願|ねんがん}だった{海外旅行|かいがいりょこう}に、ついに{行|い}くことができた。
examples.english: I was finally able to take the overseas trip I had been dreaming about for over ten years.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always used with the pattern {念願|ねんがん}の + noun, meaning "the long-desired [noun]." The most common combination is {念願|ねんがん}の{夢|ゆめ}が{叶|かな}う (a long-held dream comes true). Often appears in happy announcements or celebrations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {念願|ねんがん}の{夢|ゆめ} (long-cherished dream)
- {念願|ねんがん}が{叶|かな}う (a long-held wish comes true)
- {念願|ねんがん}の{優勝|ゆうしょう} (long-desired championship victory)
- {念願|ねんがん}だった + noun (the [noun] one had always wished for)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {悲願|ひがん}: heartfelt wish — stronger and more serious; often used for groups or organizations striving toward a difficult goal
- {願望|がんぼう}: desire, wish — more general; does not imply a long period of wanting
